title: 一等奖

lines.text: 年底，公司在一家酒店包了二十多桌，办年终聚餐。酒过三巡，大家最期待的抽奖开始了。
lines.py: nián dǐ, gōng sī zài yì jiā jiǔ diàn bāo le èr shí duō zhuō, bàn nián zhōng jù cān. jiǔ guò sān xún, dà jiā zuì qī dài de chōu jiǎng kāi shǐ le.
lines.en: At the end of the year, the company books more than twenty tables at a hotel for its year-end dinner. After a few rounds of toasts, the part everyone has been waiting for begins: the lucky draw.

lines.text: 今年的抽奖由杰克负责。他写了一个小程序，把全公司两百多个人的名字都放了进去：按一下，大屏幕上的名字飞快地滚动；再按一下，停在谁，奖就归谁。

lines.en: This year Jack is in charge of the draw. He has written a little program with the names of all two hundred-odd staff in it: press once and the names whizz across the big screen; press again, and whoever it stops on wins.
